title: BPS employed persons by highest education completed, by province, Sakernas August 2025, Indonesia

columns.province_code: BPS province code (kode_bps); 00 = Indonesia. Names and Kemendagri codes in 'provinces'.
columns.education: Highest education completed; names in 'education'. TOTAL is all levels.
columns.period: YYYY; the survey month (August) is in the indicator code.
columns.status: BPS precision marker: rse25-50 where the report marks a relative standard error of 25-50%.

education.primary_or_less: Sekolah Dasar ke Bawah (no schooling, primary not completed, or primary school)
education.junior_secondary: Sekolah Menengah Pertama, SMP (junior secondary school)
education.senior_secondary_general: Sekolah Menengah Atas, SMA (general senior secondary school)
education.senior_secondary_vocational: Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan, SMK (vocational senior secondary school)
education.university: Diploma IV, S1, S2, S3 (bachelor, master or doctoral degree)

employed_persons_august.name: Penduduk berumur 15 tahun ke atas yang bekerja selama seminggu terakhir, Sakernas Agustus (employed persons aged 15 and over, August survey), by highest education completed
employed_persons_august.source: BPS, Keadaan Angkatan Kerja di Indonesia Agustus 2025, Tabel 107

report.title: Keadaan Angkatan Kerja di Indonesia Agustus 2025, Tabel 107: Penduduk Berumur 15 Tahun ke Atas yang Bekerja Selama Seminggu Terakhir Menurut Provinsi dan Pendidikan Tertinggi yang Ditamatkan di Indonesia, Agustus 2025

webapi 1126.title: Penduduk Berumur 15 Tahun Ke Atas yang Bekerja Selama Seminggu yang Lalu Menurut Status Pekerjaan Utama dan Pendidikan Tertinggi yang Ditamatkan

notes: Table 107 pages carry hidden white text from the February 2025 edition ('Februari 2025'). It is not read; the visible heading says Agustus 2025 and the Indonesia row equals the WebAPI August 2025 totals exactly, not the February ones.
Values marked rse25-50 have a relative standard error of 25-50% (BPS footnote): Papua Selatan diploma, Papua Pegunungan SMK and diploma.
The share of workers with junior secondary schooling or less is (primary_or_less + junior_secondary) / TOTAL; it is derived in analysis/, not stored here.

format.missing: a missing row means the source has no value; no placeholder values are written
format.layout: one value per row: key columns, then status, then value

status: final, or no marker in the source
status.rse25-50: Kesalahan baku relatif 25% <= RSE <= 50% (relative standard error between 25% and 50%; use with caution)
